name: IGB Real Estate Investment Trust
summary: IGB Real Estate Investment Trust is a Malaysia-domiciled real estate investment trust. The firm owns income-producing real estate used for retail purposes in Malaysia. IGB REIT is managed and administered by IGB REIT Management Sdn Bhd, which works to increase income and enhance asset value over time with the objective of maximizing returns from investments. It seeks to own and invest in high-quality real estate portfolios. This is accomplished through active asset management, acquisition growth and capital and risk management.
